// src/services/youtubeService.ts

export interface Song {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  artist: string;
  thumbnail: string;
}

// Búsqueda simulada y lista por defecto robusta (ideal para pruebas inmediatas sin errores de cuota de API)
export const searchSongs = async (query: string): Promise<Song[]> => {
  // Catálogo de respaldo con música popular de anime/vocaloid y trap para garantizar resultados instantáneos
  const defaultSongs: Song[] = [
    {
      id: "dQw4w9WgXcQ",
      title: "Never Gonna Give You Up",
      artist: "Rick Astley",
      thumbnail: "https://img.youtube.com/vi/dQw4w9WgXcQ/hqdefault.jpg"
    },
    {
      id: "6hCL-Geyll4",
      title: "Hatsune Miku - World is Mine",
      artist: "Ryo ft. Hatsune Miku",
      thumbnail: "https://img.youtube.com/vi/6hCL-Geyll4/hqdefault.jpg"
    },
    {
      id: "MX2edmkggIU",
      title: "Kasane Teto - Territory of Light",
      artist: "Utsu-P",
      thumbnail: "https://img.youtube.com/vi/MX2edmkggIU/hqdefault.jpg"
    },
    {
      id: "YqeW9_5kURI",
      title: "Trap Beat Instrumental 2026",
      artist: "Snacky Beats",
      thumbnail: "https://img.youtube.com/vi/YqeW9_5kURI/hqdefault.jpg"
    }
  ];

  if (!query.trim()) return defaultSongs;

  const filtered = defaultSongs.filter(
    song =>
      song.title.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()) ||
      song.artist.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())
  );

  // Si no coincide con el respaldo local, devolvemos una pista dinámica basada en la búsqueda para simular la API
  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    return [
      {
        id: "jfKfPfyJRdk",
        title: `Resultado para: "${query}"`,
        artist: "YouTube Music Stream",
        thumbnail: "https://img.youtube.com/vi/jfKfPfyJRdk/hqdefault.jpg"
      }
    ];
  }

  return filtered;
};
